name: application-aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
description: Fixed-ratio containers for images, avatars, and video embeds so content never shifts layout as it loads.
useWhen: Embedding an image, video, or iframe that must reserve a predictable amount of space before it loads.
Building a media grid or card where every item needs the same proportions regardless of source image dimensions.
Wrapping a video player or thumbnail with a play-button overlay at a fixed cinematic ratio.
avoidWhen: The content's natural dimensions should drive layout — forcing a ratio would crop or distort it unexpectedly.
You need arbitrary, content-driven height, such as a text block or card body.
responsiveBehavior: The container's width comes from its parent (max-w-md/max-w-lg in the examples); height is derived automatically from the aspect-video, aspect-square, or aspect-ratio CSS value, so it reflows correctly at any breakpoint.
accessibility: Images inside the ratio container carry descriptive alt text; decorative overlay icons are marked aria-hidden.
The video play button uses an aria-label since it is icon-only.
object-cover on the image preserves visual proportions inside the fixed container instead of stretching or distorting it.
